title: HB209 (2018 Regular): AN ACT relating to the possession of firearms by persons found to have committed hate crimes.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Draft, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/18RS/HB209/bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 1690466))
provenance.note: Text read is a pre-filing draft (BR 1142, "Draft" print, "Jacketed"), not a filed or enrolled print. No votes.

operative_text: Section 1 (new section of KRS Chapter 527): (1) A person is guilty of possession of a firearm by a person found to have committed a hate crime when the person possesses, manufactures, or transports a firearm after the person has been found by a sentencing judge to have committed an offense as a result of a hate crime under KRS 532.031 and has not: (a) Been granted a full pardon by the Governor or by the President of the United States; or (b) Been granted relief by the United States Secretary of the Treasury pursuant to the federal Gun Control Act of 1968, as amended. (2) Possession of a firearm by a person found to have committed a hate crime is a Class D felony.
